content: Redesign the repository workflow skills so a coherent, verified stage breakthrough triggers a durable Git checkpoint before work expands into the next phase, while preserving separate content and record commits and keeping exploratory noise out of history.

Preserved the already verified Ubuntu 20.04/glibc 2.31 package boundary as content commit b05901a after confirming the staged diff contained only the coherent implementation and its focused checks remained green.

A stage breakthrough requires an independently nameable durable outcome, passing focused gates, a coherent reviewable/revertible diff, and a transition into a new risk or scope phase; time, file count, generated output, exploratory edits, and failing tests are not triggers.

Updated start-work and record-session to checkpoint verified breakthroughs before task closure and preserved the skill change as content commit 267edc4; both skills passed quick validation, Agent records passed, and the 23-case skill-routing self-test passed.
The semantic checkpoint trigger belongs to the active agent. Git hooks remain deterministic validators only, and session/checkpoint records follow the content commit in a separate record commit.
